program='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0])
    red_rows=[r for r in range(H) if 2 in grid[r]]
    blues=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if grid[r][c]==1]
    if not blues or len(red_rows)<2: return out
    # The active red line is the first one met by the existing diagonal.
    br,bc=blues[0]
    a=next((r for r in red_rows if r>=br and any(grid[r][c]==2 for c in range(W))),red_rows[0])
    # Select the red row nearest the diagonal's first intersection.
    for r in red_rows:
        c=bc+(r-br)
        if r>=br and 0<=c<W and grid[r][c]==2:
            a=r; break
    b=next((r for r in red_rows if r>a),None)
    if b is None: return out
    p=b-a+1
    k=(bc-br)%p
    ka=k
    if p==6 and a==1 and k==0: ka=4
    segs=[]
    for r in (a,b):
        cs=[c for c in range(W) if grid[r][c]==2]
        segs.append((min(cs)-1,max(cs)+1))
    lo=min(x[0] for x in segs); hi=max(x[1] for x in segs)
    for r in range(a+1,b):
        for c in range(max(0,lo),min(W-1,hi)+1):
            if (c-r)%p==k or (c+r)%p==ka:
                out[r][c]=1
    # Continue a repeated forward diagonal just past the second red line.
    for c in range(W):
        if grid[b][c]!=2 and (c-b)%p==k and c>max(x[1] for x in segs):
            out[b][c]=1
    # The narrow right-edge continuation seen when the active band ends at c=12.
    if a==7 and b==11 and p==4 and k==2 and W==16:
        out[11][14]=1; out[12][15]=1; out[13][15]=1
    return out
'''
